name: Glewlwyd Gafaelwar

attributes.attribute: watchman at the gates of King Arthur's court

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Glewlwyd Gafaelwar is a Welsh hero. This warrior and guardian figure came from Wales. He passed into Arthurian legend as a watchman. He guarded the gates of King Arthur's court at Camelot. His role made him a keeper of access to the king.

okr.objective: Present Glewlwyd Gafaelwar as a Welsh hero who became the gatekeeper of Arthurian Camelot.
key_results: Glewlwyd Gafaelwar was a Welsh hero and guardian.
Arthurian legend folded him in as a court watchman.
He guarded the gates of King Arthur's court at Camelot.
